scope: Two explicitly selected original Core cases and the entire original one-case restart_budget_recovery integration binary, on Windows and Linux. Full Core, full Supervisor and whole-product qualification are separate.

budgets.basis: Original native Windows Core lifecycle workflow retains a 60-minute budget; no original product job budget is changed.
budgets.wait_checks: 20 ms early / 50 ms configured default / 1 s outer guard remain unchanged
budgets.restart: 3 attempts / 300 s window / 250,500,1000 ms backoff remain unchanged

reader_reference.reused: The strict fresh-JUnit validator and failure-detail extractor are copied byte-for-byte from the actually passing Memory native qualifier. Scope-specific compiled-inventory controls are separate.

source_protection: Full tracked before/after raw bytes must match immutable Git blobs, including original locks; any formatter or scoped just fix source mutation fails acceptance and retains its full diff.
external_effect_scope: The existing Supervisor test uses its original FakeDriver and real durable budget records; it is not a live deployment or external-chain receipt.
